title: Bacterial metabolite-directed synthesis of biogenic TiO2–Zn nanocomposites: characterization and multifunctional biomedical evaluation
content:

Ibrahim M. Ibrahim, Hanadi A. Alahmadi, Anes A. Al-Sharqi, Nidal Mohammed Zabermawi, Mohammed Alsieni, Dareen Alyousfi, Faten A. S. Alsulaimany, Dalal Alfawaz, Issam Alshami, Zinab Alatawi, Ahmed Eid Alharbi, Ahmed Ghareeb
Biogenic TiO2–Zn nanocomposites from Red Sea Bacillus tequilensis MYG163 form an anatase–wurtzite heterojunction (8–15 nm) with antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, antidiabetic, and hemocompatibility activities for multitarget therapy.
